providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.freeTier: Flash, Flash-Lite and Gemma models are free with per-model daily request caps. Google no longer publishes the exact numbers; see AI Studio > Rate limits for your project. Resets at midnight Pacific. Free-tier prompts may be used to improve Google products.

providers.name: Groq
providers.freeTier: Free plan with per-model limits (reported around 30 requests/min and 1,000 requests/day on the larger models). Exact limits are on the Limits page in your Groq console.

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.freeTier: Was about 1M tokens/day. Some reports say the open free tier closed to new accounts in July 2026 and was replaced by a starter credit; older accounts may still have it.

providers.name: OpenRouter (free models)
providers.freeTier: Models ending in :free. About 20 requests/min and 50 requests/day shared across all free models (1,000/day once the account has bought $10 of credit). Some free models log prompts for training.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.freeTier: Free mode for evaluation and prototyping with the lowest rate limits. Mistral does not publish the numbers; see Admin Console > Limits.

providers.name: Cohere
providers.freeTier: Trial keys: about 20 chat requests/min and 1,000 calls per month. Non-commercial use only.

providers.name: Hugging Face
providers.freeTier: A small monthly credit for Inference Providers on free accounts. Runs out quickly, so it sits near the end of the order.

imageProviders.name: Hugging Face
imageProviders.freeTier: Uses the small monthly credit on free accounts, shared with chat. Same token as for chat.
